CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Mayor  www.SanMarinoCA.gov
Tony Chou, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone

Hunter Chang, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber

John Chou, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Calvin Lo, Council Member  San Marino, CA 91108

Philippe Eskandar, City Manager

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 11, 2025 AT 6:00 PM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov or by phone at (626)
300-0705 48 hours prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City
will do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:

  Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov until 3:00
  p.m. the day before the meeting. Written public comment received by 3:00 p.m. will
  be distributed to City Council during the meeting. Any comments received after 3:00

   p.m. will be included in the public comment record but not provided to City Council
  at the meeting.
  Written public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us
  teleconference module during the meeting. Written Zoom comments will be accepted
  after the in-person comments. Written Zoom comments will be read or summarized,
  then printed and made part of the public record for the meeting.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chang, Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Vice Mayor Chou, and
Mayor Shepherd Romey

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.SanMarinoCA.gov.
PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At
this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to
place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the City Manager to inform the City Council and the public of any
upcoming events or matters of interest to the community.

 PRESENTATION

 PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATES OF RECOGNITION FOR OUTGOING
 ADVISORY BODY MEMBERS

 PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATE OF RECOGNITION TO CALIFORNIA
 AMERICAN  WATER  AND  THE  AMERICAN  WATER  CHARITABLE
 FOUNDATION

AGENDA – JUNE 11, 2025  PAGE 2 of 4
  NEW BUSINESS

 1.  APPROVAL OF SOFTWARE LICENSING AGREEMENT WITH PSD
  CITYWIDE INC. FOR CITYWIDE ENTERPRISE ASSET MANAGEMENT
  SYSTEM IN THE NOT TO EXCEED AMOUNT OF $55,915 FOR ANNUAL
  SOFTWARE LICENSING AND IMPLEMENTATION COSTS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve a software licensing
  agreement with PSD Citywide for Use of a Citywide Enterprise Asset Management
  System, pending approval of final agreement language by the City Attorney, and
  authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement.

  “I move to approve a software licensing agreement with PSD Citywide for Use of a
  Citywide Enterprise Asset Management System, pending approval of final agreement
  language by the City Attorney, and authorize the City Manager to execute the
  Agreement.”

 CONSENT CALENDAR

 2.  APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION NO. R-25-12, ADOPTING A LIST OF
  STREET PROJECTS FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025-26 FUNDED BY SB1, THE
  ROAD REPAIR AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT OF 2017

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve Resolution No. R-25-
  12, adopting a list of fiscal year 2025-26 SB 1 projects. If the City Council concurs
  with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve Resolution No. R-25-12 adopting a list of Fiscal Year 2025-26
  projects to be funded by SB 1 Road Maintenance and Rehabilitation Account Funds.”

 3.  RATIFICATION OF PROCUREMENT FOR REPLACEMENT OF THE CITY'S
  WASH BAY AWNING IN THE AMOUNT OF $52,925 AND FUEL STATION
  AWNING IN THE AMOUNT OF $33,453

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council ratify the February 2025
  procurement of the fuel station awning replacement in the total amount of $33,453
  and March 2025 procurement of the public works wash bay awning in the amount of
  $52,925. If the Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion
  would be:

  “I move to ratify the February 2025 procurement of the fuel station awning
  replacement in the total amount of $33,453 and March 2025 procurement of the
  public works wash bay awning in the amount of $59,925 and approve budget
  adjustments necessary.”

 4.  APPROVAL TO ACCEPT $25,000 GRANT FROM THE AMERICAN WATER
  CHARITABLE FOUNDATION VIA THE LOS ANGELES FIRE DEPARTMENT

AGENDA – JUNE 11, 2025  PAGE 3 of 4
   FOUNDATION

  Recommendation: Staff recommend that the City Council accept the grant funds and
  authorize the City Manager to sign necessary grant agreements, and approve the
  necessary budget adjustments to spend said funds. If the City Council concurs with
  staff’s recommendation, the appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to accept $25,000 in grant funding from the American Water Charitable
  Foundation via the Los Angeles Fire Department Foundation, authorize the City
  Manager to sign necessary grant agreements, and approve the necessary budget
  adjustments to spend said funds.”

 5.  RECEIVE AND FILE MONTHLY DISBURSEMENTS REPORT FOR MAY
  2025

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file the Monthly
  Disbursements Report for the month of May 2025. If the City Council concurs with
  staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Monthly Disbursements Report for the month of May
  2025.”

 6.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the May 2025 Minutes. If
  the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would
  be:

  “I move to approve the Minutes of the Special Meeting of May 14, 2025, the Regular
  Meeting of May 14, 2025, the Special Meeting of May 21, 2025, and the Adjourned
  Regular Meeting of May 30, 2025.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.
